description: This file defines a class PimPluginConfiguration that implements plugin configuration for the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It initializes services related to employee management and salary via a dependency injection container.

classes.name: PimPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements the plugin configuration interface to initialize employee and salary services for the PIM plugin.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes services related to employee management and salary within the plugin using dependency injection.
